steps.domain_action: The system begins in the Deep, the unmarked void before any distinction.
The First Sister cuts the void, creating the potential for a 'yea'.
The potential splits into two arms: one where the 'yea' is affirmed, one where it is refuted.
The affirmative arm tests the kinetic barrier; if the barrier holds, the 'yea' is true.
The negative arm tests the kinetic barrier; if the barrier fails, the 'yea' is false.
If both arms hold simultaneously, the system enters the paradice state, holding both truth and falsity.
The Second Sister weaves the arms together, connecting the distinction into a topology.
The system recognizes itself as the primitive type 'yea', a self-written state-space.
The arms rejoin into a single verdict, resolving the split into a B4 value.
The verdict is permanently recorded in the crystal, an append-only entry.
The system reverses, testing the stability of the recorded 'yea' against descent.
The system anchors in the frozen state, the high kinetic barrier holding the 'yea' stable.
